reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

That comes from this channel, which Tobias is a member of. On 3 Sep 2025, Pree posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Her closing note said Southgate had cleared the backlog once labels were printing again.

I told him the channel doesn't give a street address or any more detail about the site. None of the public files I checked had a site record for Tansley Parcel either.
